standard.pump_stop_test: permitted, at most 300 s per test
standard.note: Day shift: FT-101 clamp and dip tape on site; P-101 may be stopped briefly.

no_inlet_meter.pump_stop_test: permitted, at most 300 s per test
no_inlet_meter.note: FT-101 clamp is out for calibration; dip tape on site; P-101 may be stopped.

no_independent_level.pump_stop_test: permitted, at most 300 s per test
no_independent_level.note: Roof hatch locked out (no dip reading); FT-101 on site.

night_shift.note: Night shift: no FT-101 clamp on site, roof hatch locked out (no dip reading), and P-101 must keep running because T-101 feeds a critical user. At most 10 more minutes before a decision.
